data.one_liner: A ruler‑style picker widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a scrollable ruler UI that lets users select a numeric value by sliding a marker. It works on all Flutter platforms and requires only the flutter SDK.
use_when: You need a simple, visual numeric selector resembling a ruler
You want a cross‑platform widget without native dependencies
avoid_when: You need heavy customization of the ruler appearance
You require complex input validation or integration with form libraries
strengths: Very lightweight, only depends on flutter
Works on mobile, web, and desktop out of the box
Easy to drop into any layout
